name: suppa-dev
description: Suppa-aware development plugin: the Suppa Dev Engineer agent, development commands, engineering + Suppa skills, and the bundled Suppa MCP server (Tasks, Docs, Entities, Forms).

suppa_api_key.title: Suppa API key
suppa_api_key.description: Your Suppa user JWT (used to authenticate the Suppa MCP server). Use a user token for full Tasks access — an integrator key returns empty Tasks.

suppa_base_url.title: Suppa base URL
suppa_base_url.description: Base URL of your Suppa instance.
